model.title: A bill to designate the General George C. Marshall House, in the Commonwealth of Virginia, as an affiliated area of the National Park System, and for other purposes.
model.meta: Energy and Natural Resources Committee · Sen. Timothy Kaine (D-VA)

summary.text: The law designates the General George C. Marshall House in Leesburg, Virginia, as an affiliated area of the National Park System to honor the legacy of George C. Marshall, who served as Army Chief of Staff during World War II and later held positions as Secretary of State, president of the American Red Cross, and Secretary of Defense. The George C. Marshall International Center will manage the site, with the Department of the Interior authorized to provide technical assistance and financial support for preservation, interpretation, and marketing of the historic property.
